name: Image Compressor & Resizer
short: Compress, resize & convert photos on your device. Live preview & batch mode.
full:
Compress, resize and convert your photos right on your device — and see the result before you save.

Image Compressor gives you full control over photo file sizes without giving up your privacy. Your photos are processed on your phone and are never uploaded. No account, no ads.

⚡ KEY FEATURES

• Live preview
  - See the compressed image and its real new size (e.g. 877 KB → 48 KB) while you change the settings.
  - Pinch to zoom into details and hold to compare with the original.

• Fast & smart compression
  - Low, Medium or High compression, or any quality from 10 to 100.
  - "Never make files larger": if a setting would make a photo bigger than the original, the quality is lowered just enough to keep it smaller.
  - Target file size (KB/MB): set an exact size such as 200 KB or 2 MB, and the app finds the highest quality that fits.

• Resize
  - Scale by percentage (10–100%).
  - Presets: 4K (3840 px), Full HD (1920 px), HD (1280 px), Web (1024 px), Small (640 px).
  - Custom width × height with aspect ratio lock.

• Format conversion
  - Convert between JPEG, PNG and WebP.
  - Transparent images get a white or black background when converted to JPEG.

• Batch processing
  - Compress dozens of photos at once.
  - Status for every image, cancel at any time and retry failed images.
  - Summary of the total space saved.

• Before & after comparison
  - Drag the slider to compare the original with the actual output file.
  - Exact file size, dimensions and savings.

• Privacy
  - Photos are processed on your device and are never uploaded.
  - Uses the Android Photo Picker, so no broad storage permission is needed.
  - Your originals are never modified or deleted.
  - Optional, anonymous crash reports and usage statistics help improve the app. You can turn them off at any time in Settings.

• Save & share
  - Save to Pictures/Image Compressor or any folder you choose.
  - Share through the Android share menu.
  - History of your saved results.

Supported input formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC/HEIF, GIF, BMP, AVIF.
Output formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP.
